title: MicroHealth CTO Andrew Jacobs Honored with Prestigious Accelerate 125 Health IT Leaders Award for AI Innovation
summary: MicroHealth CTO Andrew Jacobs wins Accelerate 125 Health IT Leaders Award for secure AI innovations, elevating federal IT delivery.
body_text: By Morgan Dingle | Dec 10, 2025 Vienna, Virginia – December 10, 2025 – MicroHealth LLC, a leading Information Technology company, proudly announces that Chief Technology Officer Andrew Jacobs has been recognized as an Accelerate 125 Health IT Award honoree for his pioneering work in generative artificial intelligence and secure enterprise AI solutions. The ACCELERATE 125 Health IT Awards, presented on Dec. 9, 2025, in Reston, Virginia, celebrate visionaries who are redefining excellence across emerging technologies including AI and Data, Agentic AI, Cybersecurity, Quantum Computing, and UX/UI. Jacobs joins an elite group of innovators recognized for advancing innovation, driving impact, and championing digital transformation across the federal landscape. “Generative AI is more than just technology,” said Jacobs, CTO of MicroHealth. “It is a tool to help people work smarter, make better decisions, and solve complex problems responsibly. MicroHealth’s proprietary generative AI platform shows what happens when innovation meets security and accessibility.” Transforming Federal Health IT Through Secure AI Innovation Under Jacobs’ technical leadership, MicroHealth has developed innovative artificial intelligence solutions that prioritize flexibility, security, and usability for federal healthcare organizations. His team has created advanced AI architectures that support multiple large language models simultaneously, enabling organizations to select optimal AI tools for specific use cases rather than being constrained by single-vendor solutions. Jacobs has championed the implementation of enterprise-grade security protocols that protect sensitive healthcare data and personally identifiable information (PII) while delivering powerful AI capabilities that meet federal compliance requirements, including HIPAA, FISMA, and FedRAMP standards. His vision for accessibility has resulted in AI solutions that function seamlessly across all platforms—desktop computers, mobile devices, and tablets—ensuring federal healthcare workers can leverage artificial intelligence regardless of their device or location. Advanced AI Capabilities Driving Federal Healthcare Innovation Additionally, Jacobs directed the development of advanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques and prompt engineering methodologies that significantly improve AI accuracy, reliability, and contextual awareness compared to standard large language model implementations. His team has created flexible integration frameworks that enable federal healthcare organizations to incorporate AI capabilities into existing workflows and systems without extensive custom development—reducing implementation timelines from months to days while maintaining security and compliance. As technical ambassador for MicroHealth’s AI initiatives, Jacobs has played an instrumental role in hundreds of product demonstrations for federal healthcare agencies, personally showcasing MAIKO’s capabilities while pioneering advanced safeguarding technologies that deliver contextually-aware, accurate responses. His leadership has positioned MicroHealth as a trusted leader in secure enterprise AI solutions for federal health IT. For more information For more information about MicroHealth and MAIKO, visit www.microhealthllc.com . Now that we have your attention MicroHealth is a service-disabled, Veteran-owned small business making a BIG impact in federal IT . From agile project management and advanced cybersecurity to generative AI , data analytics , software development , and more, we deliver secure, innovative solutions for government agencies and the Uniformed Services. We’re proud to be a five-time Top Workplace USA winner. See more of our awards at microhealthllc.com/about-us/awards . Stay connected with us on LinkedIn for the latest news and stories. title: Agilent Senior Vice Presidents Visit iLabService R&D Center
summary: SHANGHAI, December 3, 2025 – iLabService, a leading provider of lab digitalization and intelligence solutions, today announced that Angelica Reimann, Senior Vice President and Pres
body_text: SHANGHAI, December 3, 2025 – iLabService, a leading provider of lab digitalization and intelligence solutions, today announced that Angelica Reimann, Senior Vice President and President of Agilent CrossLab Group, and Mike Zhang, Senior Vice President and President of Agilent Applied Market Group, paid a special visit to iLabService's Research and Development Center. The delegation engaged in in-depth discussions with Kenny, Founder & CEO of iLabService, focusing on industry trends and potential collaborations in the era of AI-driven lab transformation. During the meeting, Kenny shared the founding story of iLabService and elaborated on the company's mission and vision: "Powering the future of lab operation" through digitalization and intelligence technologies to significantly enhance lab efficiency, safety, compliance, accuracy, and sustainability. He emphasized that since its establishment, iLabService has been committed to addressing pain points in lab management through technological innovation, enabling researchers to focus more on core scientific research. Following the discussion, Kenny led the Agilent executives on a tour of the iLabService exhibition hall, showcasing the company's innovative product portfolio and industry experience accumulated over more than 8 years of operation. With services covering over 7,700 clients across various sectors, iLabService has developed a series of cutting-edge solutions that integrate IoT, AI, and data analytics to optimize lab workflows. The demonstrations included real-case applications of intelligent lab management systems, which have helped clients achieve remarkable improvements in operational efficiency and risk control. A key highlight of the visit was the in-depth exchange on lab digitalization amid the AI wave. Both parties acknowledged that artificial intelligence is reshaping lab operations, from automated data analysis to predictive maintenance of equipment. They explored potential synergies between Agilent's global leadership in lab instrumentation and services and iLabService's expertise in digitalization and intelligent management solutions. The discussions covered areas such as integrated workflow development, AI-enabled lab monitoring, and sustainable lab operation solutions. "We are impressed by iLabService's achievements in lab digitalization and their deep understanding of industry needs," said Angelica Reimann, President of Agilent CrossLab Group. " Mike Zhang, President of Agilent Applied Market Group, added: "The application of AI in lab operations is creating unprecedented opportunities. iLabService's track record of serving thousands of clients demonstrates their proven solutions. We look forward to exploring how our complementary strengths can drive transformative changes in lab operations across industries." Kenny, Founder & CEO of iLabService, expressed his enthusiasm about potential collaboration: "Agilent is a globally respected leader in the lab industry. Their insights into global lab needs and technological capabilities align perfectly with our digitalization mission. We are excited about the possibility of deepening cooperation to bring innovative, integrated solutions to labs worldwide, empowering the future of scientific research." The visit concluded with a shared commitment to continue dialogue and explore specific collaboration initiatives. Both parties anticipate that their joint efforts will accelerate the digital transformation of global lab operations, setting new standards for efficiency, safety, and sustainability in the industry. About iLabService iLabService is a pioneer in lab digitalization and intelligence, dedicated to "Powering the future of lab operation" through innovative IoT, AI, and data-driven solutions. Founded in 2017, the company has served over 7,700 clients across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, environmental testing, food safety, and academic research. iLabService's product portfolio focuses on enhancing lab efficiency, safety, compliance, accuracy, and sustainability, enabling labs to achieve intelligent transformation and focus on core scientific innovation. For more information, visit www.ilabservice.us. About Agilent Technologies Agilent Technologies Inc. (NYSE: A) is a global leader in life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets. With a heritage of innovation spanning decades, Agilent provides analytical instruments, software, services, and consumables to enable customers to gain the insights they need to improve the quality of life. Agilent's CrossLab Group delivers comprehensive services, software, and耗材 support, while the Applied Market Group focuses on solutions for food, environmental, forensic, and chemical markets. For more information, visit www.agilent.com.

title: Fermi America electric service agreement reached with Xcel Energy subsidiary
summary: Fermi America announced on Friday that an Electric Service Agreement with Southwestern Public Service Company, a subsidiary of Xcel Energy, has been reached
body_text: Myhighplains.com Dec 8, 2025 by: Maci Weathers Fermi America announced on Friday that an Electric Service Agreement with Southwestern Public Service Company, a subsidiary of Xcel Energy, has been reached to provide up to 200 megawatts of electrical capacity. According to officials with Fermi America, Xcel Energy’s SPS subsidiary will begin delivering 86 megawatts of electrical capacity in 2026 and eventually ramp up to 200 megawatts. “This agreement is yet one more example of Fermi transforming intent into execution, with the strong commercial and technical support of our friends at Xcel Energy,” said Larry Kellerman, Chief Power Officer of Fermi America. “Securing reliable and cost-effective power from Xcel Energy today and working together with them to grow our relationship over time is a key component of Fermi’s plans.” Officials noted that the ESA provides up to 200 megawatts of power to the Project Matador Campus in Amarillo. The electricity will be delivered through the SPS’s high-voltage 115-kilovolt transmission system to “ensure reliable electrical service.” “Xcel Energy is focused on meeting the growing energy needs of the Texas Panhandle and is pleased to work with Fermi America on this project,” said Adrian Rodriguez, president, Xcel Energy Texas –New Mexico. title: TotalEnergies announces the commencement of trading of its ordinary shares on the NYSE
summary: Paris, December 8, 2025 – TotalEnergies SE (NYSE: TTE) announces, as of today, December 8, 2025, the commencement of trading of its ordinary shares on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”), replacing the listing of its American Depositary Receipts (“ADRs”). These ordinary shares trade under the same ticker symbol “TTE” as the one on Euronext […]
body_text: Paris, December 8, 2025 - TotalEnergies SE (NYSE: TTE) announces, as of today, December 8, 2025, the commencement of trading of its ordinary shares on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”), replacing the listing of its American Depositary Receipts (“ADRs”). These ordinary shares trade under the same ticker symbol “TTE” as the one on Euronext and as the former ADR ticker. On October 30, 2025, the Company had announced the termination of its American Depositary Receipts (“ADRs”) program and the conversion of ADRs into ordinary shares, with each ADR exchangeable for one NYSE-listed ordinary share. As of December 8, 2025, TotalEnergies converted all outstanding ADRs into ordinary shares listed on the NYSE. You may visit the Investor website section for more information. ****

title: H!GHEND wins at Cans of the Year 2025
body_text: AMP-Europe’s Candy-Can x Pac-Man collaboration was recognised with Bronze in the Ends, Caps and Closures category at The Canmaker Cans of the Year Awards 2025. The award recognises the outstanding collectible can series, created to celebrate 45 years of the iconic Pac-Man game. The series features 45 uniquely designed ends, each showcasing retro Pac-Man artwork that captures the spirit and nostalgia of the original game. The designs were brought to life using our innovative H!GHEND technology, demonstrating how premium decoration on can ends can transform packaging into a powerful brand experience. Commenting on the award, Gerlof Toenhake, Director Sales at Ardagh Metal Packaging-Europe, said: “Candy-Can x PAC-MAN cans represent fun and nostalgia, but above all, they reflect the trust of our customer and the teamwork that made them possible. When all these elements come together, great things happen. We’re thrilled to see our H!GHEND innovation recognised once again, and even prouder of the people behind it. With 45 different H!GHEND designs, this edition is truly one-of-a-kind – a celebration of creativity and innovation.” Congratulations to everyone involved in bringing this creative concept to market - and thank you to our partners for their collaboration and trust.

title: BD innovators and a rising leader recognized by the Society of Women Engineers

body_text: MediaRoom Dec 17, 2025 BD innovators and a rising leader recognized by the Society of Women Engineers At BD, collaboration isn’t just a value—it’s how we deliver on our Purpose of advancing the world of health ™. By bringing together diverse perspectives, we unlock innovation that improves patient care and strengthens healthcare systems worldwide. This commitment was on full display at the Society of Women Engineers’ (SWE) WE25 Conference where BD earned multiple awards. The accolades reflect both excellence and innovation, from groundbreaking patents to rising leaders shaping the future of engineering, and our commitment to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, supported and empowered to do their best work, transforming healthcare around the world. Gold Mission Recognition Award BD was one of just five organizations that received the Gold Mission Recognition Award. This award celebrates organizations that exemplify SWE’s core values and demonstrate continuous improvement in advancing STEM. For BD, this award highlights the efforts of the Women’s Initiative Network Associate Resource Group and underscores our commitment to fostering an inclusive culture and driving initiatives that contribute to meaningful innovation. SWE Patent Recognition Award Eight BD associates were honored with SWE’s Patent Recognition Award, which celebrates members who have been granted patents in engineering, technology or related sciences within the past three years. Collectively, these innovators were recognized for 33 new patents, showcasing our focus on advancing healthcare through purpose-driven solutions: Lisa Bailey, Sr Staff Engineer, Product Development from Salt Lake City, Utah – 6 patents Emily Goel, R&D Product Manager from Tempe, Ariz. – 1 patent Kelly Hon, Sr Manager, Product Development Engineering from San Diego, Calif. – 2 patents Claire Knight, Sr Manager, Medical Affairs from San Diego, Calif. – 2 patents Melody Kuroda, Staff Engineer II from Durham, N.C. – 1 patent Caroline Ottinger, Clinical Manager, Specimen Management from Covington, Ga. – 1 patent Clémentine Le Loc’h, Manager R&D from Le Pont-de-Claix, France – 14 patents Janice Pak, Staff Engineer from Brea, Calif. – 6 patents New Professional Member Engineer Award WIN member Alice Connelli, Senior R&D Engineer, received SWE’s Esteemed New Professional Member Engineer Award. The organization recognized Alice for her outstanding contributions to the engineering field, leadership within SWE, and her dedication to serving the broader community. Alice has made a lasting impact through her work in engineering and community engagement: She has led innovative projects focused on advanced tissue regeneration and been awarded multiple patents for her work. Alice has championed STEM engagement by holding leadership roles within the Society of Women Engineers and our BD Women’s Initiative Network Associate Resource Group, developing programming at BD in North America for STEM Day and Engineers Week, and mentoring collegiate students to inspire the next generation of innovators. Her influence extends globally as she orchestrated the global implementation of the BD R&D Day of Giving, mobilizing more than 1,000 associates across 19 sites to volunteer in support of local causes. The recognitions we received at SWE’s WE25 Conference are more than accolades, they represent the impact of diverse perspectives in shaping the future of healthcare. We are proud to partner with SWE as we’re advancing engineering excellence and building a culture where every voice can influence meaningful change. Together, we’re creating solutions that improve healthcare systems worldwide. Learn more about our commitment to inclusion and engagement and explore career opportunities at BD. title: Royaume-Uni : TotalEnergies fusionne ses activités amont avec NEO NEXT, donnant naissance au plus grand producteur indépendant de pétrole et de gaz du Royaume-Uni
summary: TotalEnergies fusionnera ses activités amont au Royaume-Uni avec NEO NEXT, positionnant ainsi NEO NEXT+ comme le plus grand producteur indépendant de pétrole et de gaz au Royaume-Uni. TotalEnergies détiendra une participation de 47,5 % dans la nouvelle entité élargie NEO NEXT+. La nouvelle structure actionnariale, le portefeuille d’actifs et la taille de NEO NEXT+ généreront des […]
body_text: TotalEnergies fusionnera ses activités amont au Royaume-Uni avec NEO NEXT , positionnant ainsi NEO NEXT + comme le plus grand producteur indépendant de pétrole et de gaz au Royaume-Uni. TotalEnergies détiendra une participation de 47,5 % dans la nouvelle entité élargie NEO NEXT +. La nouvelle structure actionnariale, le portefeuille d'actifs et la taille de NEO NEXT + généreront des synergies et un fort cash-flow , tout en contribuant à l'approvisionnement énergétique du Royaume-Uni. Paris, le 8 décembre 2025 – TotalEnergies a signé un accord avec NEO NEXT Energy Limited ( NEO NEXT ) prévoyant que les activités amont de la Compagnie au Royaume-Uni seront fusionnées avec NEO NEXT et que TotalEnergies deviendra l'actionnaire principal de la nouvelle entité élargie NEO NEXT , qui sera renommée NEO NEXT +, avec une participation de 47,5 %. Après la finalisation de la transaction, NEO NEXT + sera : détenue conjointement par TotalEnergies (47,5 %), HitecVision (28,875 %) et Repsol UK (23,625 %) ; dotée d'un large portefeuille d'actifs diversifié comprenant notamment les intérêts de NEO Energy et de Repsol UK dans le complexe Elgin/Franklin ainsi que dans les champs Penguins , Mariner , Shearwater et Culzean , enrichi par les actifs amont de TotalEnergies au Royaume-Uni, notamment ses intérêts dans le complexe Elgin/Franklin et les champs Alwyn North , Dunbar et Culzean . Avec TotalEnergies comme principal actionnaire, NEO NEXT + deviendra le plus grand producteur indépendant de pétrole et de gaz au Royaume-Uni, avec une production supérieure à 250 000 barils équivalent pétrole par jour en 2026. L'entreprise sera idéalement positionnée pour maximiser la valeur de son portefeuille, générer une rentabilité élevée et garantir un avenir durable et résilient à long terme pour ses activités oil & gas . « Cette transaction témoigne de l'engagement durable de TotalEnergies envers le secteur pétrolier et gazier britannique et la sécurité énergétique du pays. En tant que nouvel actionnaire principal de NEO NEXT +, nous sommes ravis d'apporter notre expérience reconnue en tant qu'opérateur majeur en mer du Nord britannique, où nous sommes présents depuis plus de 60 ans. L'attention constante de TotalEnergies de mener des opérations à bas coûts et faibles émissions sera déterminant pour générer des économies d'échelle au sein du nouveau portefeuille de NEO NEXT +, ce qui renforcera la génération de cash-flow de la société dès la clôture de l'opération », a déclaré Patrick Pouyanné, Président-directeur général de TotalEnergies. La finalisation de la transaction est soumise aux conditions habituelles, notamment l'approbation du régulateur et est attendue durant le premier semestre 2026. ***

title: Inovação e conexão com o mercado: momentos que marcaram a história Datlo em 2025
summary: Em 2025, a Datlo fortaleceu sua atuação por meio de inovação, evolução da plataforma e conexão com o mercado. Conheça os momentos que marcaram esse ano.
body_text: Algumas transformações não acontecem de uma vez. Elas se acumulam. Um investimento que destrava decisões, um produto que muda de escala, uma conversa que sai da sala interna e passa a circular no mercado. Em 2025 a Datlo viveu exatamente esse tipo de movimento. Não foi um ano definido por um único grande anúncio, mas por uma sequência de escolhas que apontaram para o mesmo lugar: mais clareza sobre o papel da inteligência de mercado no crescimento das empresas e sobre a relevância da Datlo nessa construção. Entre avanços em tecnologia, presença ativa nos principais fóruns de inovação e a criação de espaços próprios de troca sobre Go-To-Market , 2025 consolidou a Datlo, de forma definitiva, como referência em inteligência de mercado orientada à decisão. Aporte da Hiker Ventures: capital para escalar ainda mais Em maio de 2025, anunciamos um aporte de R$ 4 milhões , liderado pela Hiker Ventures , braço de venture capital da boutique de M&A Araújo Fontes. O investimento, uma extensão da nossa rodada seed, teve um foco claro: acelerar o desenvolvimento da plataforma e viabilizar nossa expansão internacional , com atenção especial ao mercado norte-americano. Esse movimento reforçou um momento importante de maturidade da Datlo. Hoje, atendemos mais de 200 clientes ativos , que juntos, representam cerca de 7% do PIB brasileiro , além de participações relevantes em setores estratégicos da economia. O aporte também marcou o segundo grande investimento da nossa história. Em 2021, fomos acelerados pela Y Combinator , fundo global responsável por impulsionar empresas como Airbnb, Dropbox e Twitch. Leia mais em: Datlo recebe aporte de R$4 milhões e mira em internacionalização EUA Datlo Summer Release: produtos e novo posicionamento 2025 também foi o ano em que decidimos ir além dos bastidores e apresentar, de forma pública, a evolução da Datlo. O Datlo Summer Release marcou a primeira edição de um evento criado para reunir parceiros, empresários e lideranças do mercado em um encontro presencial, com transmissão online. Mais do que lançar novidades, o evento apresentou um novo posicionamento da marca . Durante o encontro, conduzido pelo nosso CEO e fundador, Mateus Felini , apresentamos novos produtos e dados que ampliam a granularidade das análises e fortalecem a tomada de decisão em estratégias de prospecção e expansão. Com apoio da Evoa Aceleradora , o Summer Release consolidou o pioneirismo da Datlo ao unir inteligência artificial, território e estratégia comercial em uma única plataforma. Leia mais: A plataforma para Go-To-Market: conheça os novos produtos Datlo Rio Innovation Week: a Datlo no centro da conversa sobre inovação Nossa presença em 2025 também se fez nos grandes palcos de inovação do país. À convite da ASSERJ (Associação de Supermercados do Estado do Rio de Janeiro), participamos do Rio Innovation Week , um dos maiores eventos de tecnologia, inovação e negócios da América Latina. Marcando presença no centro de discussões junto ao varejo e supermercadistas. No evento, reforçamos nossa conexão com o ecossistema de inovação, levando o know-how da Datlo em inteligência geográfica para dialogar com empresas de diferentes segmentos. O objetivo foi claro: discutir tendências, abrir espaço para parcerias estratégicas e mostrar, na prática, como dados territoriais e inteligência de mercado orientam decisões mais eficientes, especialmente quando o assunto é expansão e novos territórios. Nexo GTM: criando espaços para quem faz o mercado avançar Por fim, demos mais um passo importante ao criar nossos próprios espaços de diálogo e conexão com o mercado. O Nexo GTM nasceu com o propósito de reunir empresas e lideranças que estão moldando o futuro da indústria, promovendo conversas práticas sobre os desafios do Go-To-Market e o papel da inteligência de mercado nesse processo. Em 2025, realizamos edições do Nexo GTM em Belo Horizonte e São Paulo , reunindo executivos e gestores para discutir temas como expansão territorial, prospecção estratégica e tomada de decisão orientada por dados. Mais do que apresentar tendências, os encontros fomentaram trocas reais, experiências práticas e conexões entre empresas que estão à frente da transformação do mercado brasileiro. O Nexo GTM marca o início de um movimento contínuo da Datlo: fortalecer a comunidade, provocar reflexões estratégicas e contribuir ativamente para a evolução das práticas de Go-To-Market no país. Um ano de construção e de novos territórios Os acontecimentos de 2025 mostram uma Datlo em plena evolução. Investimos em conexões, amadurecemos nosso posicionamento, ocupamos espaços estratégicos e criamos fóruns relevantes de discussão sobre o mercado. Seguimos fortalecendo nosso propósito em 2026, com o olhar voltado para novos territórios, novas decisões e ainda mais impacto. Conheça mais sobre a Datlo aqui.

title: New Year’s Plant-Based Crostini
summary: This holiday season, make these easy vegan crostini. Layered with plant-based meat, horseradish cream, and pickled onions, they’re guaranteed crowd-pleasers.
body_text: Why You’ll Love This Recipe Easy to Prepare - All this festive recipe requires is combining ingredients, some pan action, and assembly. Visually Stunning - This simple and delicious appetizer looks absolutely marvellous and way more complicated than it actually is. A Great Way to Start the Evening - Impress your guests with this fancy vegan appetizer paired with a glass of red wine. Key Ingredients for New Year’s Crostini The Thick-Cut Filet gets simply pan-fried and thinly sliced. Its savory, umami flavours pair perfectly with horseradish. Horseradish adds sharpness and spice. Rustic Baguette gets toasted until golden brown and rubbed with garlic. Plant-based Yogurt and Mayonnaise are the body of the horseradish cream, bringing creaminess and richness with a slight tang. Chives add a burst of green colour and an herbal, oniony flavour. Pickled Pearl Onions add a nice visual touch as well as a kick of acidity that balances out the horseradish cream and meaty Filet. Equipment You’ll Need Cutting board Sharp knife Measuring spoons and cups/kitchen scale Small bowl for mixing the horseradish cream Large non-stick pan for toasting bread and cooking the filet Heavy pan or chef’s press for toasting the bread (optional) Kitchen tongs or spatula How To Prepare New Year’s Crostini 1. Prepare the Horseradish Cream Add all the ingredients to a small bowl and whisk until combined. Cover and store in the fridge until ready to serve. 2. Toast the Bread Slice the baguette at a slight angle into 14 pieces, keeping the ends for a midnight snack or breadcrumbs. Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add bread baguette slices and cook for 3 minutes on each side, until golden brown. Optionally, place a heavy pan or chef’s press on top of the bread to increase surface contact and achieve better toasting. Once the bread is toasted on both sides, remove the pan from the heat. Rub each slice with garlic, and return to the pan to keep warm. 3. Cook the Filets Remove the Thick-Cut Filets from the packaging and season with salt and pepper on all sides. Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the Filets and thyme. Cook for 8-9 minutes, until nicely browned on all sides. Remove from the heat, and slice each filet into 7 thin slices, and keep warm. 4. Assembly Take a toasted slice of the baguette, and spread a small amount of horseradish cream in the middle. Place a slice of filet on top, together with another dollop of cream in the center. Finish with a few pickled pearl onions and a sprinkling of thinly sliced chives. Tips & Tricks Make It Fancy. Serve the New Year’s Crostini on your fanciest serving platter, topped with a sprinkle of chives and flaky salt. Prep Ahead Of Time. Prepare what you can ahead of time to make the serving of this vegan appetizer as smooth as possible. Pair It Up. Serve the crostini with your favorite red wine, crudites, and briny things. FAQ Can I prepare this in advance? This dish is most delicious served hot. You can prepare the horseradish cream, slice chives, and bread ahead of time, but toasted bread and Thick-Cut Filet are best prepared fresh. Is the horseradish cream spicy? The horseradish cream is slightly spicy, but you can adjust the spiciness level according to your preference. Start with a small amount, and add as much as you like. Can I omit horseradish? Of course. You can swap it with finely chopped fresh herbs like chives, parsley, or basil. Can I prepare this recipe gluten-free? Yes, just swap the bread for a gluten-free option. *Note: while Marbles Meats aren’t gluten-free certified, we do not use gluten in our recipe. What kinda of wine should I pair with vegan crostini? Pair the vegan crostini with red wine like Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz, Merlot, or Pinot Noir.

title: Top 10 Hemingway Editor Alternatives to Try in 2026
summary: Give these Hemingway Editor alternatives a try to check your grammar and improve your writing with AI in 2026.
body_text: Having software that proofreads your work and checks grammar can make a big difference in how polished your writing looks. Whether you’re drafting articles, essays, or emails, these tools help you catch mistakes, rewrite awkward sentences, and make your writing clearer.
